title: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Chewy chocolate chip cookies with crisp edges and a nutty, toffee-like flavor from browned butter. The dough rests before baking for a deeper caramel taste.

source.prompt: Seed recipe: a classic brown butter chocolate chip cookie

items.note: cold from the fridge is fine

step_groups.name: Brown the butter
steps: Cut the butter into pieces and melt it in a light-colored saucepan over medium heat, swirling now and then. It will foam, crackle, and then go quiet.

Keep cooking and swirling until the milk solids on the bottom turn deep golden brown and the butter smells nutty, about 5 to 7 minutes. Pour it, scraping in every brown bit, into a large heatproof bowl and let it cool for 15 minutes.

step_groups.name: Make the dough
steps: Whisk the flour, baking soda, and kosher salt together in a medium bowl.
Whisk both sugars into the cooled brown butter until smooth. Whisk in the eggs one at a time, then the vanilla, until the mixture looks glossy and thick.
Fold in the dry ingredients with a spatula until just a few streaks of flour remain, then fold in the chocolate. Do not overmix.
Cover the bowl and chill the dough for at least 30 minutes, or up to 3 days for even deeper flavor.

step_groups.name: Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F (190°C) with racks in the upper and lower thirds. Line two sheet pans with parchment.
Scoop the dough into balls about the size of a golf ball and place them 2 inches (5 cm) apart on the pans, about 12 per pan.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, swapping and rotating the pans halfway through, until the edges are set and golden and the centers still look slightly soft.
Sprinkle the tops with flaky salt right out of the oven. Cool on the pan for 5 minutes, then move to a rack.

notes: Browning loses some water, which is why the dough rests: the flour has time to hydrate and the cookies bake up chewier.
For wide, crinkly cookies, bang the pans on the counter once when they come out of the oven.
Unbaked dough balls freeze well. Bake from frozen at the same temperature, adding 1 to 2 minutes.
storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days. Rewarm for a few seconds in the microwave for a melty center.
